links.outcome: Medication reconciliation F1 across four input serialisation formats and five models
links.effect: Serialisation strategy had a large significant effect for models up to 8B; Clinical Narrative outperformed Raw JSON by up to 19 F1 points for Mistral-7B (r = 0.617, p < 10^-10); reversed at 70B.
links.quote: Clinical Narrative outperforms Raw JSON by up to 19 F1 points for Mistral-7B (r = 0.617, p < 10^{-10}).

unlisted_practices: Selecting input data serialisation format (Clinical Narrative vs Raw JSON) according to model size for FHIR-based LLM tasks

screen.practice: FHIR data serialisation format (input formatting) selection
screen.reason: The study directly tests and compares deployment data pre-processing strategies (FHIR serialization formats: Raw JSON, Markdown Table, Narrative, Timeline) to optimize LLM performance and safety in medication reconciliation.
